title: Extended Krull dimension equality for a regular sequence
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $r_1,\ldots,r_c\in R$ be an $R$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Writing Mathlib's extended Krull dimension as $\operatorname{ringKrullDim}(R)\in\operatorname{WithBot}\,\mathbb N_\infty$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], one has $$\operatorname{ringKrullDim}(R/(r_1,\ldots,r_c))+(c:\operatorname{WithBot}\,\mathbb N_\infty)=\operatorname{ringKrullDim}(R),$$ where the quotient is by the ideal generated by the list. When both dimensions are finite, this is the usual equality of natural Krull dimensions plus $c$.

mathlib_searches.query: A regular sequence in a Noetherian local ring gives quotient Krull dimension equal to ring dimension minus sequence length
regular sequence quotient Krull dimension plus length equals ring Krull dimension

mathlib_match.how: exact (lines 210–214): `ringKrullDim (R ⧸ Ideal.ofList rs) + rs.length = ringKrullDim R` in `WithBot ℕ∞`, with `rs.length` coerced to that type

from.place: The fixed-tuple Cohen–Macaulay criterion's forward implication: a regular sequence cuts Krull dimension by its length.
